rules.title: Prohibition Against Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
rules.requirement: Landlords in Hoboken may not use software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms that collect private information from competing landlords to coordinate, recommend, or set rents, lease terms, or occupancy levels.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios en Hoboken no pueden usar programas, algoritmos o plataformas de intercambio de datos que recopilen información privada de otros propietarios competidores para coordinar, recomendar o fijar alquileres, términos de contrato o niveles de ocupación.
rules.coverage_text: Any residential dwelling unit in Hoboken, defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities.
rules.penalty: Upon conviction, one or more of: penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5; a fine not exceeding $2,000; or community service not exceeding 90 days. Enforced by the Division of Housing or an aggrieved private citizen in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.quote: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
